business_summary: Southchip Semiconductor Technology(Shanghai) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, and sale of analog and embedded chips in China and internationally. The company offers automotive power ICs comprising buck-boost/boost, buck, LDOs, and PMIC/SBC; automotive driver ICs consisting of high side and motor drivers, eFuses, and interfaces; automotive charging ICs, including USB charging interfaces and all in one, and wireless power stages; general dc-dc products, such as buck-boost DC-DC, buck DC-DC, and boost DC-DC; load switches; and industrial high voltage chargers. It also provides PFC controllers; flyback converters comprising USB-PD SSR flyback controllers and SR with integrated GaN; synchronous rectifier controllers and synchronous rectifiers with integrated MOSFETs; PD/DPDM controllers; AMOLED PMIC and LPDDR; switching chargers, such as buck-boost, buck, and boost chargers; charge pump and linear chargers; wireless chargers, including wireless transmitters and receivers; battery protectors; and microcontrollers, which include entry level RISC-V and power MCUs. The company's products are used in automotive applications comprising zone controllers, smart junction boxes, smart cockpits, smart driving, and in-vehicle USC and wireless charging; industrial computing applications consisting of portable energy storage, building automation, GPS tracker, and vacuum robots; and consumer electronics applications, such as phone battery packs, smartphones, tablets, power banks, TWS, smart watches, chargers, laptops, hubs, docking, monitors, and smart speakers. In addition, it provides technology promotion and application; warehousing logistics and IC design; and trade, research and development, and technical services. Southchip Semiconductor Technology(Shanghai) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Southchip Semiconductor Technology(Shanghai) Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 아날로그 및 임베디드 칩의 연구, 설계, 개발 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 벅-부스트/부스트, 벅, LDO 및 PMIC/SBC로 구성된 자동차 전력 IC를 제공합니다. 하이사이드 및 모터 드라이버, eFuse 및 인터페이스로 구성된 자동차 드라이버 IC; USB 충전 인터페이스와 올인원 및 무선 전력 스테이지를 포함한 자동차 충전 IC; 벅-부스트 DC-DC, 벅 DC-DC, 부스트 DC-DC 등의 일반 dc-dc 제품; 부하 스위치; 산업용 고전압 충전기. 또한 PFC 컨트롤러도 제공합니다. USB-PD SSR 플라이백 컨트롤러와 GaN이 통합된 SR로 구성된 플라이백 컨버터; MOSFET이 통합된 동기 정류기 컨트롤러 및 동기 정류기; PD/DPDM 컨트롤러; AMOLED PMIC 및 LPDDR; 벅-부스트, 벅 및 부스트 충전기와 같은 스위칭 충전기; 충전 펌프 및 선형 충전기; 무선 송신기 및 수신기를 포함한 무선 충전기; 배터리 보호 장치; 그리고 보급형 RISC-V 및 전원 MCU를 포함하는 마이크로 컨트롤러가 있습니다. 이 회사의 제품은 z로 구성된 자동차 애플리케이션에 사용됩니다.
